messages:
ajay: heads up — provisioning failures started ~09:12 UTC in ap-southeast due to repeated OOB connection backoff on BMCs after the 3.0.0fw push. nodes stay in PROVISIONING and never reach SSH, autoscaler keeps retrying which is burning our reserved GPU minutes. :grimacing:

maria: seeing same. ipmi logs show a ton of `connection reset by peer` and `rate limited` entries. can someone confirm firmware version?

kevin: checked node rack-17: BMC reports `fw_ver=3.0.0` and `oob_rate_limit=50/s`. after the rollout a lot of management sessions hit the new limiter.

ajay: that matches. rollout note said default rate limit tightened — probably to protect management plane but it collides with our parallel provisioner.

sara: impact: autoscaler cannot power-cycle or mount iPXE; provision jobs timeout at 10m. we have ~24 GPU slots stuck, queued jobs failing, and we're still paying reserved capacity for those racks. estimates: ~12 GPU-hours wasted so far.

kevin: quick mitigation: reduce parallelism in the provisioner and add exponential backoff to BMC calls. in the short term we can bump `oob_rate_limit` on affected BMCs but that requires IPMI creds and might be risky at scale.

ajay: agree. plan: 1) throttle provisioner to max 3 concurrent BMC sessions per rack, 2) patch provisioner to honor 429/RateLimit headers, 3) emergency override: revert oob rate limit to 200/s on the problematic racks (manual). who can run the manual change?

maria: I can do the manual for rack-17 and rack-18. give me IP ranges and the one-liner.

kevin: one-liner to use against the vendor API (needs auth token):

```
curl -sS -X POST https://oob-mgmt.vendor.local/api/v1/bmc/config \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENDOR_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"target_rack":"rack-17","oob_rate_limit":200}'
```

kevin: if using `ipmitool` directly (only if vendor API down):

```
# run from bastion in mgmt VPC
ipmitool -I lanplus -H $BMC -U admin -P $PASS raw 0x30 0x70 0x0c 0x01 0xc8
# sets rate limit to 200 (0xc8)
```

ajay: tagging infra-bot for runbook link and to escalate if manual change fails. infra-bot: runbook? :eyes:

infra-bot: Runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/oob-rate-limit -- contains rollback steps, verification, and postmortem checklist. Escalation: oncall->eng-infra->eng-sre.

maria: manual API change applied to rack-17. watching logs.

kevin: logs show fewer `rate limited` entries after ~30s. provisioning started progressing for 3 nodes.

ajay: good. still want this fixed in the provisioner so we don't repeat. kevin — can you open a PR to add concurrency control + exponential backoff? tag me for review.

kevin: will do. I'll also add a feature flag to slow rollout of any future BMC fw that changes mgmt defaults.

sara: questions for product/finance: with 24 GPUs stuck we lost about 12h of usable time — that's ~X USD in reserved costs. can we get an estimate to show execs?

ajay: estimate: reserved cost per GPU-hour = $0.80 (bookkeeping rate). so ~12h * 24 * 0.8 = ~$230. add extra overhead for failed jobs ~100-150. cc finance if you want a formal chargeback.

maria: rack-18 manual change next. will rotate through 4 racks total. leaving rack-19 alone for canary to validate vendor API fix.

kevin: note for postmortem: vendor also changed default secure-boot toggles concurrently in 3.0.0 — toggling wasn't the cause here but it created a scary signal in our health checks. ensure runbook includes secure-boot verification step before bulk rollouts.

ajay: agreed. action items:
- kevin: PR for provisioner (concurrency + backoff) + feature flag for fw-defaults (due EOD).
- maria: manual bump on remaining affected racks (in-progress).
- sara: cost estimate + informal exec note (by EOD).
- ajay: coordinate with vendor for staged fw re-deploy and request a changelog entry for mgmt default changes.

sara: thanks everyone. ping me if costs move higher. :thumbsup:

maria: rack-18 done. provisioning cleared 8 nodes. continuing on rack-20/21 next.

kevin: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/provisioner/pull/512 — adds concurrent limiter and handles 429s from BMC API.

ajay: great. marking this thread for postmortem capture. I'll start a draft and include timeline + cost.

infra-bot: Incident recorded: INC-2026-0421. Postmortem owner assigned: ajay.

kevin: I'll queue a canary job to validate remaining racks after patch.

maria: all affected racks patched. provisioning backlog cleared. keeping a 1-hour watch. :white_check_mark:
